visualCharacteristics: Centered, max-width video player. Shows a poster image with a circular play button until clicked; then loads the video (MP4, YouTube, or Vimeo). Reserves 16:9 space to avoid layout shift.
contentPattern: First row labels the block ('Video'). Second row: a link to the video source, plus an optional poster image.
usage: Standalone centered promotional/explainer video with a poster and play button.
